description: This file defines reflection-based encoding and decoding mechanisms for JSON serialization, including struct descriptors, field bindings, and extension points for custom encoding/decoding logic.

classes.name: StructDescriptor
classes.description: Describes how to encode/decode a struct type, including its fields.

classes.name: Binding
classes.description: Represents how a specific struct field should be encoded/decoded, including field info, encoder, decoder, and name mappings.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Interface for customizing struct encoding/decoding, including updating descriptors and creating decorators.

classes.name: EncoderExtension
classes.description: Map-based extension for encoding, implementing Extension interface.

classes.name: DecoderExtension
classes.description: Map-based extension for decoding, implementing Extension interface.

methods.name: GetField
methods.description: Retrieves a struct field binding by name from a StructDescriptor.

methods.name: UpdateStructDescriptor
methods.description: No-op method for extensions to modify struct descriptors.

methods.name: CreateMapKeyDecoder
methods.description: Creates a decoder for map keys, default is no-op.

methods.name: CreateMapKeyEncoder
methods.description: Creates an encoder for map keys, default is no-op.

methods.name: CreateDecoder
methods.description: Creates a decoder for a given type, default is no-op.

methods.name: CreateEncoder
methods.description: Creates an encoder for a given type, default is no-op.

methods.name: DecorateDecoder
methods.description: Wraps a decoder with additional behavior, default is identity.

methods.name: DecorateEncoder
methods.description: Wraps an encoder with additional behavior, default is identity.

methods.name: RegisterTypeDecoderFunc
methods.description: Registers a type decoder with a function.

methods.name: RegisterTypeDecoder
methods.description: Registers a type decoder.

methods.name: RegisterFieldDecoderFunc
methods.description: Registers a field decoder with a function.

methods.name: RegisterFieldDecoder
methods.description: Registers a field decoder.

methods.name: RegisterTypeEncoderFunc
methods.description: Registers a type encoder with a function.

methods.name: RegisterTypeEncoder
methods.description: Registers a type encoder.

methods.name: RegisterFieldEncoderFunc
methods.description: Registers a field encoder with a function.

methods.name: RegisterFieldEncoder
methods.description: Registers a field encoder.

methods.name: RegisterExtension
methods.description: Adds a new extension to the global extensions list.

methods.name: getTypeDecoderFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a decoder for a type, considering extensions and registered decoders.

methods.name: _getTypeDecoderFromExtension
methods.description: Internal logic to find a decoder for a type considering extensions and registered decoders.

methods.name: getTypeEncoderFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves an encoder for a type, considering extensions and registered encoders.

methods.name: _getTypeEncoderFromExtension
methods.description: Internal logic to find an encoder for a type considering extensions and registered encoders.

methods.name: describeStruct
methods.description: Creates a StructDescriptor for a given type, analyzing struct fields and tags.

methods.name: createStructDescriptor
methods.description: Constructs a StructDescriptor, merging embedded fields and applying extensions.

methods.name: sortableBindings.Len
methods.description: Returns the number of bindings.

methods.name: sortableBindings.Less
methods.description: Defines sorting order for bindings based on their levels.

methods.name: sortableBindings.Swap
methods.description: Swaps two bindings in the list.

methods.name: processTags
methods.description: Processes struct field tags to set encoding/decoding options.

methods.name: calcFieldNames
methods.description: Calculates field name mappings based on struct tags and field visibility.
